title: Selective Successor Eligibility Traces for RLVR
abstract: arXiv:2605.05965v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a key approach for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, widely used critic-free algorithms such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) suffer from coarse-grained temporal credit assignment, as they assign the same trajectory-level advantage to all tokens and fail to distinguish the contributions of different reasoning steps. To address this challenge, we propose Selective Successor Eligibility Traces (S-trace), an critic-free eligibility trace method that enables more effective credit assignment. S-trace introduces successor importance reweighting to recover downstream credit signals under PPO-style clipping and propagates them to selected historical tokens through entropy-based token selection. translated_title: 面向可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的选择性后继资格迹
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的关键方法。然而，广泛使用的无评论家（critic-free）算法（如组相对策略优化GRPO）存在时间信用分配粗粒度的问题：它们将相同的轨迹级优势分配给所有token，无法区分不同推理步骤的贡献。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了选择性后继资格迹，这是一种无评论家的资格迹方法，能够实现更有效的信用分配。S-trace引入后继重要性重加权机制，在PPO风格的裁剪下恢复下游信用信号，并通过基于熵的token选择将其传播到选定的历史token上。在理论上，我们建立了其与基于原始资格迹的策略梯度估计器之间差异的上界，并……
tldr: 提出S-trace方法，通过后继重要性重加权和基于熵的token选择，在无评论家的RLVR训练中实现更精细的token级信用分配，从而更好地区分不同推理步骤的贡献。
en_tdlr: S-trace is a critic-free eligibility trace method that recovers downstream credit signals via successor importance reweighting and propagates them through entropy-based token selection, enabling finer-grained token-level credit assignment in RLVR.
